visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A brown-furred animated character with large black circular eye patches stands behind a teal-colored store counter. A small box resembling a cigarette pack sits on the counter. The background is white and minimalist. The character is looking towards the viewer area with a neutral expression. (2) Transition to a close-up of a pink, blob-like character wearing black-rimmed glasses and a thin red tie. The character's face is flushed red in the center, and he exhibits a wide-mouthed, angry expression while shouting. The background remains white and sterile. (3) The scene cuts rapidly between the two characters as their argument intensifies. The pink character's facial expressions become increasingly exaggerated and distorted with anger, while the brown character maintains a stoic, then frustrated look, eventually shouting back with eyes widened. (4) A blue door opens in the background, and a white, round animated character wearing a teal shirt with "店長" text in Chinese enters. He gestures broadly with his arms. The brown character is seen in the foreground looking startled and then hanging his head. (5) The pink customer character is shown in profile, looking smug with a slight grin and crossed arms, believing the manager is siding with him. The background is simple and white. The manager character is partially visible, speaking toward the cashier. (6) A final close-up of the white manager character reveals him looking directly at the cashier with a deadpan, intense expression. He has rosy cheeks and a small, round mouth. The visual tone shifts from aggressive confrontation to a comedic revelation.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, high-tempo electronic synthesizer BGM starts with a steady, rhythmic beat. A male voice (cashier) speaks with moderate pitch and clear articulation, delivering a standard customer service phrase. The acoustic environment is very dry, characteristic of studio recording with no ambient room tone. (2) A sharp, percussive sound effect marks a transition. A second male voice (customer) enters with high intensity and vocal strain, shouting with a high pitch and rapid speech rate. The BGM continues in the background, slightly ducked under the shouting voice. (3) A series of rapid vocal exchanges occur. Both male voices exhibit high arousal and emotional intensity. The speech-music overlap is constant, with the synthesizer BGM maintaining a consistent 120 BPM tempo. There are frequent hard cuts in the audio track following the fast visual editing. (4) A distinct mechanical "thud" and door-opening SFX triggers a new phase. A third male voice (manager) enters with a booming, authoritative, and loud tone. His voice has a lower pitch than the previous speakers and exhibits strong projection and command. (5) The customer's voice returns with a lower arousal level and a smug, slightly nasal tone, conveying confidence. The BGM melody remains simplistic and repetitive. A "whoosh" sound effect accompanies a visual transition as the manager turns back to the cashier. (6) The manager's voice drops to a neutral, enunciated tone for the final punchline. A sudden digital "pop" or "ding" sound effect emphasizes the end of the video. The BGM cuts off abruptly with a brief reverb tail, leaving a second of studio silence.

The video's purpose is to entertain through exaggerated character reactions and a subverted ending where the manager seemingly insults the customer's intelligence rather than punishing the employee.
